name: com.bonfanti.myunicave
description: Fork of UniCAVE 2.0.1 (UW Madison Living Environments Lab) ported to Unity 6 with Netcode for GameObjects and URP. Adds row-interleaved passive stereo for CAVE2 Planar panels, multi-instance window repositioning for cluster nodes with multiple GPUs per host, and a CAVE2 cluster prefab plus PowerShell launcher templates.
